about: After the FLhd header, an FLdt chunk holds a stream of events. The id decides the size: below 64 one byte, below 128 two, below 192 four, from 192 a varint length then the data (192-207 mostly text, 208 and up mostly data). Numbers are little-endian. The project's settings come first, then patterns, channels, the playlist and the mixer; each channel starts with event 64, each pattern with 65 and each mixer insert with 236.

events.name: channel on
events.about: In a channel's events: 1 when the channel (or automation clip) plays, 0 when it's switched off in the Channel Rack (its green light). An event 0 before the first channel is something else (0 in some FL 25 files) and isn't read.
events.proof: FL 25 and 26 test files (1 on every channel); FlStudioTests.ReadsMutedPlaylistTracksAndSwitchedOffChannels

events.name: shuffle
events.about: The song's swing, 0-128: FL delays odd steps by shuffle × step / 256 ticks (36 moves them 3 ticks at 96 PPQ). Only old FL's step dots are swung here; newer FL saves steps as notes already placed.
events.proof: FlStudio9Tests.ReadsFl9StepSequencerDrumsAndPlaylist; funk step_8 against FL 25's re-save of it

events.name: time signature (beats)
events.about: Beats in a bar (the time signature's top number), going by PyFLP.

events.name: channel type
events.about: 0 sampler, 2 plugin (instrument), 4 audio clip, 5 automation clip.

events.name: channel insert (old)
events.about: The mixer insert a channel feeds, in older versions; newer ones use 104.

events.name: registered copy
events.about: 1 when saved by a registered FL Studio, going by PyFLP; not checked.
events.proof: PyFLP's event list (Licensed); FL 25 test files

events.name: new channel
events.about: Starts a channel's events: the channel's number in the channel rack, from 0.

events.name: new pattern
events.about: Starts a pattern's events: the pattern's number, from 1.

events.name: tempo (old)
events.about: The tempo in whole BPM, in old projects without event 156.

events.name: sample flags
events.about: A sampler channel's sample flags: 0x2 plays it backwards, going by PyFLP. Not yet seen in a save; a reversed audio clip is listed in the notes, not carried over.

events.name: step volume
events.about: FL 9 and older, in a channel's events after the pattern (65) it belongs to: low byte the step, high byte its volume (velocity, 100 by default).
events.proof: FlStudio9Tests.ReadsFl9StepSequencerDrumsAndPlaylist; funk step_8 against FL 25's re-save of it

events.name: step
events.about: FL 9 and older, in a channel's events after the pattern (65) it belongs to: a step sequencer dot, 256 + the step (a 16th note). Newer FL saves steps as notes (224) with no length.
events.proof: FlStudio9Tests.ReadsFl9StepSequencerDrumsAndPlaylist; funk step_8 against FL 25's re-save of it

events.name: step shift
events.about: FL 9 and older, after the pattern (65) it belongs to: low byte the step, high byte how far it's moved, in 192nds of a beat (24 moves a step 12 ticks at 96 PPQ).
events.proof: FlStudio9Tests.ReadsFl9StepSequencerDrumsAndPlaylist; funk step_8 against FL 25's re-save of it

events.name: mixer slot
events.about: Ends a mixer slot's events: the slot's number in its insert (0 to 9), which event 225 and automation targets use. The slot's plugin events come before it.

events.name: new arrangement
events.about: Starts an arrangement (FL 12.9 onwards), its number from 0. Its name (241), playlist (233), tracks (238, 239) and markers (148, 205) follow; the next 99 starts the next arrangement.

events.name: channel insert
events.about: The mixer insert a channel feeds.

events.name: channel colour
events.about: A channel's colour as 0x00BBGGRR; FL's default is 0x6A655C (grey).

events.name: root key
events.about: A channel's root key as a MIDI note; not saved when it's C5 (60).

events.name: marker position
events.about: A timeline marker's position in ticks; the top bits (above 0x07FFFFFF) say what kind of marker it is, going by PyFLP. Its name (205) follows.

events.name: pattern colour
events.about: A pattern's colour as 0x00BBGGRR, going by PyFLP; absent when it's the default.
events.proof: PyFLP's event list; not yet seen in a test file

events.name: tempo
events.about: The tempo × 1000 (128000 is 128 BPM).

events.name: FL build number
events.about: The last part of FL's version: 5319 for 25.2.5.5319.
events.proof: Matches the version (199) in FL 25 test files; PyFLP calls it FLBuild

events.name: three-byte event
events.about: Meaning unknown. Its id says four bytes, but FL 25 and 26 write three; reading four garbled what follows.

events.name: channel name (old)
events.about: A channel's name in older projects; newer ones use 203.

events.name: title
events.about: The song's title from Project info.

events.name: sample path
events.about: A sampler channel's sample. Paths in FL's user data folder start with %FLStudioUserData%.

events.name: version
events.about: The FL Studio version that saved the project, e.g. 25.2.5.5319. Always 8-bit text; text events are UTF-16 from 11.5.

events.name: plugin type
events.about: The kind of plugin a channel or mixer slot holds: FL's own (3x Osc, Fruity Limiter) or Fruity Wrapper, FL's host for VST and CLAP plugins.

events.name: plugin name
events.about: The name a channel shows (or a mixer slot's plugin).

events.name: insert name
events.about: A mixer insert's name; it comes just before the 236 that starts the insert.

events.name: marker name
events.about: A timeline marker's name, after its position (148).

events.name: genre
events.about: From Project info.

events.name: artists
events.about: From Project info.

events.name: plugin state
events.about: A plugin's settings. For Fruity Wrapper, a record list (see the wrapper records); for FL's own plugins, each plugin's own format.

events.name: sampler settings
events.about: A sampler channel's settings (168 bytes in FL 25), its time stretching among them: Time (0 when off; PyFLP's reading), pitch in cents, multiplier (2 to the power raw / 10000, so 10000 plays twice as long) and mode (-1 stretch, 0 resample, 1 and up FL's stretch engines).
events.layout: time i32@96, pitch i32@100, multiplier i32@104, mode i32@108

events.name: envelope
events.about: A channel's envelope and LFO, five per channel (pan, volume, mod X, mod Y, pitch), 68 bytes. Layout from PyFLP; an envelope switched on hasn't been checked in a real file yet.
events.layout: flags i32@0, on i32@4, delay i32@8, attack i32@12, hold i32@16, decay i32@20, sustain i32@24, release i32@28

events.name: channel levels
events.about: Pan 0 to 12800 (6400 the centre), volume 0 to 12800 (10000, 78%, the default), pitch in cents.
events.layout: pan i32@0, volume i32@4, pitch i32@8

events.name: pattern notes
events.about: A pattern's notes, 24 bytes each (20 before FL 7). A length of 0 is a step from the step sequencer; bit 0x20 of byte 19 marks a note muted in the piano roll; velocity 0 to 128. Fine pitch, release and pan are PyFLP's layout.
events.recordLayout: position u32@0, flags u16@4, channel u16@6, length u32@8, key u16@12, fine pitch u8@16, release u8@18, mute bits u8@19, pan u8@20, velocity u8@21

events.name: mixer settings
events.about: Every mixer insert's levels and slot switches as 12-byte records. The target's high word is a base + 64 × insert + slot (base 0x2000 in FL 21, 0x7000 in FL 25 and 26; the app takes the smallest one with a fader), its low word the setting: 0x1fc0 fader (12800 is FL's default 0 dB), 0x1fc1 pan (0 centre), 0x1f00 a slot's effect on (1) or off (0), 0x1f01 a slot's mix. 0x40000000 is the song (12800 in every file so far).
events.recordLayout: zero u32@0, target u32@4, value i32@8
events.proof: Solomon's FL 21.0.2, 25.2.5 and 26.1.5 files and civil_18 (switched-off slots match FL); FlStudioTests.ReadsMixerInsertSettingsEffectSlotsAndWhatAutomationMovesOnThem

events.name: automation link
events.about: Which channel an automation clip is and what it moves. Target on a channel: low word 0 volume, 1 pan, 4 pitch, 7 on/off (the Channel Rack's green light; FL saves it as steps, and 0.5 or more is on), 0x8000 + n a plugin's setting n; high word the channel. On the mixer the high word is event 225's base + 64 × insert + slot, with low word 0x1fc0 the fader, 0x1fc1 the pan, 0x1f00 a slot's on/off and 0x8000 + n the slot's effect's setting n. High word 0x4000 is the song: low word 0 the master volume, 5 the tempo (inferred, not yet seen in a test file).
events.proof: Solomon's FL 25.2.5 test files and civil_18 (on/off and an insert effect's setting); DawProjectTests.ReadsRootKeyPitchLevelsAndAutomationFromFl25; FlStudioTests.AutomatedOnOffMutesWhatPlaysWhileTheChannelIsOff

events.name: playlist
events.about: The arrangement's clips. Item above 20480 is a pattern (item - 20480), otherwise a channel's clip (audio or automation). Track 499 is track 1, counting down. Flags bit 0x2000 is muted. The start offset at 24 is an integer before FL 21 and a float since; -1 is none. It is in ticks into a pattern, and in milliseconds into an audio clip's sample (FL 25: a clip trimmed to start halfway through a 32 second sample says 16000). FL 9 has 0 at 4 and 0x6000 at 6, and at 12 the row counted down from 999: row 999 - n plays pattern n (funk step_8 against FL 25's re-save of it).
events.recordLayout: position u32@0, pattern base u16@4, item u16@6, length u32@8, track u16@12, flags u16@18

events.name: automation points
events.about: An automation clip's points after a 21-byte header: each point's time is in beats since the one before. Points are joined by straight lines here; tension isn't read yet.
events.recordLayout: beats since previous f64@0, value f64@8, tension f32@16, flags u32@20

events.name: insert flags
events.about: Starts each mixer insert's events, the master (0) first.

events.name: project time
events.about: When the project was first made and how long FL Studio has had it open, both in days (Delphi dates: days since 30 Dec 1899). Saving again, even in a newer FL Studio, keeps the made date.
events.proof: Solomon's FL 25.2.5 and 26.1.5 test files (the same made date in both); LibraryTests.FlStudioKeepsWhenAProjectWasMadeAndHowLongItWasOpen

events.name: playlist track
events.about: One per playlist track (500 per arrangement): u32 its number from 1, u32 its colour 0x00BBGGRR (default 0x565148), then its settings; byte 12 is 1 when the track plays and 0 when it's muted (PyFLP's 'enabled'; every track plays in the test files so far). Its name (239) follows when it was given one.
events.layout: number u32@0, colour u32@4, plays u8@12

events.name: playlist track name
events.about: A playlist track's name, after its 238, going by PyFLP; only for tracks that were named.

wrapper.name: VST2 ID
wrapper.about: A VST2 plugin's unique ID: a number that's also four letters (Serum is XfsX).

wrapper.name: plugin's own state
wrapper.about: VST2: a 21-byte header, then the plugin's chunk or its settings as floats. VST3: another record list (see vst3).

vst3.name: component state
vst3.about: The plugin's processor state: its sound.

vst3.name: setting IDs
vst3.about: u32 count, then the plugin's own ID for each setting in the order FL lists them. FL's automation of setting n moves ID n of this list (Serum 2 in FL 26: setting 205 is 2000003).
